stories.title: N.S. school support workers’ union seeks renewed talks after members reject offer
stories.summary: The union representing school support workers in Nova Scotia is calling on the provincial government to resume contract negotiations by noon on Monday.

stories.title: Nova Scotia marks Transgender Day of Remembrance with flag raising and poetry
stories.summary: The annual occasion honours transgender and gender-diverse people whose lives were lost to anti-transgender violence and hatred.

stories.title: Donations pour in for residents displaced by Glace Bay fire and explosion
stories.summary: The community of Glace Bay, N.S. in Cape Breton is coming together to support those affected by a devastating fire and explosion on Commercial Street.

stories.title: New Brunswick adopts HPV testing for cervical cancer, Nova Scotia urged to follow
stories.summary: Nova Scotia's Official Opposition is calling on the province to quickly adopt HPV testing for cervical cancer and transition away from the traditional Pap test.

stories.title: New Brunswick latest province to bring in ground rules for data centre projects
stories.summary: The New Brunswick government is bringing in a new set of ground rules for data centre projects, but critics question whether they go far enough.

stories.title: EverWind says Cape Breton AI data centre project on track despite concerns
stories.summary: A representative of EverWind, the company behind a massive data centre project in Cape Breton, says everything is moving ahead as planned.

stories.title: N.S. woman’s face and neck seriously injured by police dog: police oversight agency
stories.summary: A woman in Nova Scotia is recovering from serious injuries to her face and neck caused by a police dog.

stories.title: Explosion, fire destroy building in downtown Glace Bay and sends 14 to hospital
stories.summary: An explosion and large fire in downtown Glace Bay, N.S. has destroyed a building and sent 14 people to hospital.

stories.title: Norwegian Cruise Line drops Halifax from select 2027 sailings, but port expects strong season
stories.summary: The changes affect select Norwegian Breakaway's seven-day Bermuda round-trip sailings from Boston, and will see passengers extending their stay in Bermuda instead.

stories.title: Scientists find possible explanation for North Atlantic right whales’ low birth rates
stories.summary: Scientists are one step closer to understanding why the critically endangered population of North Atlantic right whales produces so few calves each year.
